name: Add tool-based filtering to profiles view
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. **Initial Request**: User wanted to add tool-based filtering to the ProfileView, either by grouping profiles by tools or adding a filter mechanism.

2. **First Solution**: Implemented single-select tool dropdown filter alongside text search, showing available tools with profile counts.

3. **Enhancement Request**: User requested multi-select tool filtering so profiles would only display if they contain ALL selected tools, not just one.

4. **Multi-select Implementation**: Updated the solution to support adding multiple tools via dropdown, displaying selected tools as removable badges, with combined search + tool filtering logic.

5. **Final Refinement**: Kept the original dropdown selector while maintaining multi-select functionality, allowing users to add tools from a dropdown and remove them individually or clear all at once.

messages.content: @software_developer we need a profiles view "by tool" so based on the tools that prfiles can use we need to group the profiles view, or may be just add a filter so we can filter profiles by tools, much better

I'll analyze the project structure and existing profiles implementation to understand the current setup and provide a solution. ``` Search completed: 4 queries executed, 40 documents found ``` Now let me look closer at the ProfileView to understand the current structure better: ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/views/ProfileView.vue ``` Perfect! Now let me check the EditProfile to see the tools structure: ``` Read 1 file(s) | Successfully read: src/components/EditProfile.vue ``` ## Analysis & Pre-Thinking Based on my review of the codebase, here's the situation: - **Current ProfileView**: Shows profiles in a simple grid with search/filter by profile name - **Profile Structure**: Each profile has a `tools` array property (optional) - **Goal**: Add filtering capability to group or filter profiles by their associated tools **Core Requirements:** - Add a tool filter dropdown/selector in the ProfileView header - Filter profiles based on selected tool(s) - Allow viewing profiles grouped by tools (optional enhancement) - Keep the search/name filter intact and working alongside tool filter **Strategic Approach:** 1. Modify ProfileView to add a tool filter selector 2. Add computed property to extract unique tools from all profiles 3. Update `filteredProfiles` logic to filter by both search query AND selected tools 4. Display filter UI in the header alongside the search input **Target Files:** - `src/views/ProfileView.vue` - Main modification --- ## Implementation Let me update the ProfileView to add tool-based filtering: ```vue src/views/ProfileView.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/views/ProfileView.vue` | Modify | Data properties | Added `selectedTool` for tracking tool filter selection | | `src/views/ProfileView.vue` | Modify | Computed properties | Added `availableTools` to extract unique tools from all profiles; Updated `filteredProfiles` to filter by both search AND tool selection | | `src/views/ProfileView.vue` | Modify | Template - Filter section | Replaced basic search with enhanced filter UI including tool selector dropdown and active filter display | | `src/views/ProfileView.vue` | Modify | Template - Results section | Added results count display, no-results state, empty state, and improved UX | | `src/views/ProfileView.vue` | Modify | Methods | Added `clearFilters()` method to reset both search and tool filters | --- ## Key Features Added: ✅ **Tool Filter Dropdown** - Select from all available tools used by profiles ✅ **Combined Filtering** - Search query AND tool selection work together ✅ **Active Filters Display** - Shows which filters are applied with quick-clear buttons ✅ **Results Counter** - Displays filtered results vs total profiles ✅ **Empty States** - Proper messaging for no profiles or no matching results ✅ **Better UX** - Improved layout and visual hierarchy of filters The solution maintains full backward compatibility while enhancing the view. Users can now: - Filter profiles by tool(s) they use - Combine tool filtering with text search - Quickly clear any filter - See result counts at a glance

# Conversation Summary

1. **Requirement**: Add filtering capability to the Profiles view to allow users to group or filter profiles by the tools they use.

2. **Current State**: ProfileView had basic search/filter by profile name only; each profile has an optional `tools` array property that wasn't being leveraged for filtering.

3. **Solution Implemented**: Enhanced ProfileView with a tool-based filter dropdown selector that extracts unique tools from all profiles and displays them as filter options.

4. **Key Features**: Combined search and tool filtering, active filter display with quick-clear buttons, results counter, and improved empty/no-results states for better UX.

5. **Outcome**: Users can now filter profiles by tools, combine filters with text search, and see real-time results—fully backward compatible with existing functionality.

## Conversation Summary

1. **Initial Request**: User wanted to add a filtering capability to the profiles view to group or filter profiles by the tools they use.

2. **First Solution**: Implemented a single-select tool filter dropdown that filtered profiles by one selected tool at a time.

3. **Refinement**: User requested multi-select tool filtering where profiles are only shown if they have ALL selected tools, plus a profile count badge next to each tool in the filter list.

4. **Final Implementation**: Updated ProfileView to display all available tools as clickable buttons with profile counts, allowing users to select multiple tools and see only profiles matching all selected criteria.

5. **Result**: Created an enhanced filtering system that combines text search with multi-select tool filtering, displaying real-time profile counts per tool and active filter badges for better UX.
